dogecoin.text: Just in: Public companies out here using their balance sheets like degen wallets—MSTR stacking sats, Coinbase scoring all-time highs, Bit Origin going full meme with a Dogecoin treasury, and Sharplink aping into ETH like it’s Black Friday. Corporate FOMO is real.

XRP just did what bears called impossible—new ATH after 7 years of “dead chain” memes. Dogecoin’s chilling, waiting for its next absurd run. Ethereum’s prepping for a big move, still not overcooked. Altcoin season isn’t coming, frens. It’s here. Blink and you’ll miss it.

Solana just flexed 104,000 TPS in a “just for fun” mainnet burst—literally surpassing Visa’s best day and leaving every other L1 in the dust. Meanwhile, Qubic tried (and failed) to 51% Monero and now Dogecoin is on deck. Crypto never sleeps and chaos is bullish.

Dogecoin mining goes Wall Street, Trump fam in the mix, and memecoins are officially corporate. Thumzup buys Dogehash, renames it XDOG, and slides onto Nasdaq. ETH whales flexin’ hard too—SharpLink gobbling $600M in ETH last week. Memes are money now, frens.
